timing_definition: query_seconds is observed physical wall. pre_answer_seconds includes selector/packing/compaction; answer_call.wall_seconds plus small logging overhead completes query. tokenize_seconds is nested across these phases, and compaction_seconds includes its tokenizer work: neither is added again.
evidence_limits: Protocol/UTC logs are local mutable evidence, not externally signed preregistration.

Frozen code clears token-count cache at each query; original per-tokenize HTTP payloads/responses are not individually logged, so cache-reset behavior is supported by code and per-query request counts, not a complete tokenization wire trace.
Complete HTTP request payloads and selected response timing fields are saved; full raw server responses are not retained.
C preserves unique raw/import/summary body strings. It changes headers, repetition, grouping and positional presentation; equivalent reasoning behavior is not guaranteed.
New questions reuse six original synthetic projects and summaries. Old questions are explicitly exploratory regression; this is not validation on independent real repositories.
